2. The facts, in short, are that the plaintiff filed the suit for declaration of title and mandatory injunction in respect of the land described in the schedule of the plaint within C.S. Khatian No. 588 of Guyhpur Mouza within the Municipality of Bogra. 

 4. The said suit was contested by the defendant Nos. 1, 2 and 4 denying all Material allegation by the plaintiff and contending, inter-alia, that the suit land was acquired in the year 1957 for the extension of agriculture in the name of Agricultural Directorate at the office of Thana Agricultural Officer, Bogra and the land has been rightly recorded in the Khatiji Khatian in the name of Agricultural Extension Office.
